posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
The pelvic floor contains 3 layers of muscles supporting the uterus, bladder, and rectum.
Pregnancy, childbirth, and menopause all weaken these critical muscles.
posts.cta: Your pelvic floor has 3 critical muscle layers.

posts.headline: Fact
posts.body:
Olive oil's oleocanthal has the same anti-inflammatory mechanism as ibuprofen.
3–4 tablespoons of EVOO per day is therapeutic.
posts.cta: Olive oil is ibuprofen in food form.
